findings.finding: FY2026 capex guidance US$60-64bn (value verified in management's prepared remarks, fool_transcript.txt line 209-210) cites only dc_call_q3_2026, a Motley Fool copy (independent false, provider_normalized), not an issuer document; guidance must cite issuer documents.
findings.fix: Cite an issuer document (TSMC IR call transcript/webcast or the 6-K) for the capex budget, or keep the Fool copy with syndicated_from naming the TSMC 2026-10-15 call and add the issuer source next to it; until then treat it as a management statement read from a third-party copy.

findings.finding: Competitor numbers do not cite the competitors' own sources: Samsung, SMIC and UMC shares and revenues come from TrendForce search excerpts (fd_trendforce_2q26, plus the syndicated fd_evertiq_2q26), GFS from a Counterpoint excerpt, and Intel's external foundry revenue US$293M from a MarketBeat search excerpt of the call (independent false, syndicated_from null). UMC and GFS are SEC filers and Intel's 10-Q is on EDGAR.
findings.where: gather/field.json competitors SSNLF, 0981.HK, UMC, GFS (metrics), INTC metrics.external_foundry_revenue_2Q26_usd; sources fd_trendforce_2q26, fd_counterpoint_2q26, fd_intel_q2_2026
findings.fix: Replace with each competitor's own filing or release (UMC 6-K/20-F, GFS 10-Q, Intel Q2 2026 10-Q/release, Samsung and SMIC IR), or relabel these rows as third-party industry share estimates (not competitor-reported numbers) and keep them out of drivers; set syndicated_from on fd_intel_q2_2026 to Intel's call.

findings.finding: The prior-quarter guidance rows (Q3 2026 revenue 44.6-45.8bn, GM 65-67%, OM 56-58%) are issued 2026-07-16 but cite the 2026-10-15 presentation; the guiding release nm_rel_20260716 was read and states the same values (reading/release_20260716.txt lines 17-20), so the issue date is no longer inferred.
findings.fix: Set source_id to nm_rel_20260716 (the release that guided) and drop the 'inferred date' gap.

findings.finding: Duplicate quarterly facts disagree by rounding: nm lane wrote NT$1,494,240m / 763,060m (Q3 2026 revenue / net income), 1,134,100m (Q1 2026 revenue) and 505,740m (Q4 2025 net income); the releases say 1,494,243 / 763,064 / 1,134,103 / 505,744 (NT$ million).
findings.where: gather/numbers.json facts nm_revenue_q3_2026, nm_net_income_q3_2026, nm_revenue_q1_2026, nm_net_income_q4_2025 (vs documents.json dc_f_rev_3q26, dc_f_ni_3q26)

findings.finding: Net income basis differs across years: pf_net_income_fy2024 (1,157,523.9m) is total net income incl. NCI, nm_net_income_fy2025 (1,697,604.0m) is attributable to parent (lane noted it; <0.1%).
findings.fix: Use the parent FY2024 figure 1,158,380.2m (20-F) for growth rates, or state the basis next to the series.

findings.finding: Two cash scopes in the series: nm_cash_fy2025 (2,767.9bn) and nm_cash_q2_2026 (3,134.2bn) are cash and equivalents; dc_f_cash_3q26 (4,016.98bn) is cash and marketable securities (Q2 2026 on that basis 3,518.01bn; Q3 cash and equivalents ending balance 3,621.89bn, presentation slide 7). Mixing them overstates the Q3 liquidity change.
findings.fix: Label the scope in the metric name and use one basis in the capital bridge (cash and equivalents 3,621.89bn plus marketable securities separately).

findings.finding: Provenance flags: dc_call_q3_2026 is a copy of the issuer call with syndicated_from null; mc_press_nanjing is 'Reuters-based' with syndicated_from null and a date of 2026-01-01 that looks like a placeholder, not the publication date; mc_press_anthropic (KuCoin re-report of an S-1, original not read) is marked independent true; mc_6k_20261015 is the same Q3 release as dc_rel_q3_2026 under a different URL spelling (CIK with leading zeros), so pack-merge will not deduplicate it and it counts as a second independent source.
findings.where: gather/documents.json source dc_call_q3_2026; gather/macro.json sources mc_press_nanjing, mc_press_anthropic, mc_6k_20261015
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from (TSMC call; Reuters; Anthropic S-1) and independent false on the copies, correct mc_press_nanjing's date to its real publication date or drop it from any driver, and point mc_6k_20261015 at the dc_rel_q3_2026 URL (or replace its uses with dc_rel_q3_2026).

findings.finding: No attributed consensus (AV not called, FMP analyst denied) and no Q3 2026 consolidated 6-K yet (Q3 operating cash detail, share count and balance sheet from the presentation only); equity at 2025-12-31 differs by NT$64.6bn between the 20-F and the Q2 6-K comparative. All recorded as lane gaps; they must stay visible next to the result.
findings.fix: Keep as visible gaps; no consensus-based row in the table.
